title: Aromatic Herbal Turkish Fish Kebabs
description: This pescatarian-friendly dish features herbal flavors and Szechuan peppercorns, grilled to perfection on a yakimono-grill, making it a cozy Turkish meal.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, toasted Szechuan peppercorns, thyme, oregano, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cod cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated cod cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional thyme and lemon wedges if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
